assets.prompt:
Create ONE flat 2D UI pictogram icon. Square 1:1 PNG, 1024x1024, with a native transparent background (a real alpha channel, fully transparent everywhere outside the symbol). The symbol is a single solid pure white (#FFFFFF) filled shape, bold and simple like a solid Material or Font Awesome icon, rounded stroke ends, even stroke weight, centred with about 10% padding on every side, crisp anti-aliased edges. No gradients, no shading, no texture, no glow, no drop shadow, no outline, no border, no background shape, no text, no letters, no numbers. It must stay readable at 16 pixels.

Subject: A person running to the right in mid-stride, matching the bold, solid, rounded pictogram style of ref-runner.png: a round head at the top right, the torso leaning forward, one arm swinging forward and one arm back, the front leg bent with its foot down, the back leg kicked out behind.

Deliver one isolated white symbol as a transparent PNG with preserved native alpha. All surrounding and internal empty space must be fully transparent. No scenery, solid backdrop, checkerboard, floor, frame, or unwanted shadow. This is an individual runtime-tinted UI icon for the HELLSCRIPT rift result screen, not a screenshot or icon sheet.
